translations.web: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.
translations.bsb: None of the sins he has committed will be held against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.
translations.kjv: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
translations.asv: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be remembered against him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
